notes.rings_8k: 16384 x 4 RGBA strip under the 8k (ultra) key: x = 74,500 -> 140,220 km (4.0 km/px), alpha = 1 - mean transmission at normal incidence from the X-band (3.6 cm) optical depth; tau above the detection threshold (~4, opaque B-ring core) is held at the threshold. Shows the Colombo/Maxwell/Huygens gaps, Cassini Division, Encke (133,589 km) and Keeler (136,530 km) gaps and the F ring (modelled from published visible parameters: core a = 140,221 km, Bosh et al. 2002; envelope tau ~0.02, Showalter et al. 1992 - not detected at X band). RGB luminance = effective particle albedo obtained by inverting the ring shader against the Voyager lit-side I/F at 47 deg phase (so the renderer reproduces the measured brightness at that geometry). Radio tau underestimates visible tau slightly in dusty regions (C ring, Cassini Division, F ring).

albedo.note: Map is albedo-calibrated: mean linear luminance (|lat|<60) equals this geometric albedo; do not scale again in the material. Colour = sRGB.

notes.color_4k: True colour: channel factors fixed on Uranus (sRGB 172,208,214 reference), same factors for Neptune; albedo-calibrated (mean linear luminance |lat|<60 = 0.41); hue+albedo already in the map (use hdTint [1,1,1]). Native resolution 0.5 deg/px (~216 km/px), smoothly upsampled. Observed fraction 0.77 (latitudes 49 to -90); the rest is the nearest observed zonal mean (illustrative fill). Longitudes are System III, not tied to fixed features.
